name: False Gods
overview: Scripture clearly commands exclusive devotion to the one true God, forbidding the worship or even mention of other gods, as emphasized in Exodus 20:3 and Exodus 23:13. This exclusive worship underscores the truth that Jesus Christ is the only way to the Father, affirming that no one can come to God except through Him, as stated in John 14:6. Together, these verses reveal that false gods are not only prohibited but also ineffective in leading people to God, highlighting the necessity of Christ-centered faith.
